contentfulBlogPost.title: Modernising Equifax UK Marketing Website

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Project Overview

  • Organisation: Equifax UK (Consumer Services)
  • Timeline: September 2022 – January 2024
  • Team: Cross-functional delivery spanning internal Product Managers, Compliance & Legal, Acquisition & Retention Leads, external agency partners, and frontend developers.
  • Core skills demonstrated: UX Strategy & Interaction Design, Frontend Architecture (React, HTML5, CSS3), Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO), Behavioural Analytics, Technical SEO, and WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility.

What this project proves about me: I bridge high-level product strategy, user experience design, and hands-on frontend engineering to deliver measurable commercial growth in strictly regulated enterprise environments.

The Challenge

Equifax is a globally recognised credit reference agency, yet its UK consumer-facing marketing web platform suffered from legacy technical debt and user friction. Quantitative analytics showed healthy top-of-funnel traffic volumes, but conversion to core products—such as Credit Report & Score and Statutory Credit Reports—lagged expectations.

Core Problems Identified

  1. Trust Deficit & Visual Friction: Qualitative surveys revealed that users perceived the dated visual style and fragmented layouts as misaligned with a modern, secure financial institution.
  2. Information Scarcity & High Drop-Offs: The journey from homepage to conversion was interrupted by sparse product clarity, cluttered call-to-action (CTA) hierarchies, and inadequate responsive optimisation.
  3. Accessibility & Regulatory Constraints: The site required complete compliance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AA) and strict Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) promotional rules, leaving zero room for deceptive UX patterns.
  4. Search Visibility Gaps: Disorganised content architecture and poor metadata diminished organic search performance across high-intent consumer finance queries.

My Process

To de-risk the redesign and align diverse stakeholders across legal, brand, and commercial functions, I structured the initiative into four distinct phases:

  1. Discovery & Quantitative Auditing: Behavioural mapping via Glassbox and Hotjar, qualitative user survey synthesis, and organic search indexing audits via SEMrush.
  2. Hypothesis Formation & CRO Experimentation: Establishing iterative A/B testing streams using Optimizely and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to validate structural layouts prior to full-scale codebase refactoring.
  3. UX/UI Design & Accessibility Prototyping: Designing responsive components in Figma, mapping interactive tab-stops, establishing accessible colour contrast tokens, and integrating credible social proof mechanisms.
  4. Modular Frontend Engineering & Rollout: Translating UI systems into accessible React components, instrumenting granular event-tracking, and coordinating compliance validation across all deployments.

What I Did

Operating at the junction of technical execution and product strategy, I directed the end-to-end user experience and managed implementation across technical teams and external agencies.

1. Research-Led Diagnostics

I analysed Glassbox session replays to identify rage-clicks and layout shifts occurring across mobile viewports. The legacy navigation suffered from hidden sub-menus and weak visual contrast, leading users to churn before discovering product tiers. In response, I led an audit documenting keyboard navigation pathways and tab orders to lay the groundwork for full accessibility compliance.

2. Information Architecture & Content Restructuring

Working with SEO specialists and product marketers, I overhauled the content hierarchy of the core commercial landing pages. I introduced modular comparison cards, sticky tab navigations, and expandable FAQ accordions designed to capture long-tail search queries while reducing cognitive fatigue on mobile devices.

3. Design System & Frontend Component Architecture

In Figma, I crafted a refreshed, spacious visual aesthetic incorporating modern typography, high-contrast CTAs, and verified Trustpilot integrations. As a frontend developer and engineering manager, I architected reusable React components with clean semantic HTML5, fluid CSS3 layouts, and ARIA landmarks to ensure seamless performance, cross-browser stability, and rigorous accessibility.

Why I Made These Decisions

  • Replacing Aggressive Promos with Direct Social Proof: Fintech users seek safety. Instead of relying on pushy marketing banners, I integrated dynamic Trustpilot widgets directly alongside key decision points. This elevated consumer confidence and directly reduced exit rates on conversion funnels.
  • De-prioritising Raw Homepage Traffic in Favour of Intent-Based Routing: We intentionally streamlined the homepage to act as a clear signpost rather than trying to force conversions directly on the landing screen. Diverting qualified visitors deeper into dedicated product pages improved overall funnel efficiency, even when raw homepage traffic dropped.
  • Accessibility-First Component Engineering: Rather than treating WCAG compliance as a post-launch audit checklist, I embedded accessibility markers and tab sequences directly into Figma designs and React component specs, eliminating costly structural remediation during regulatory reviews.
  • Structured Data for Long-Tail SEO Capture: Incorporating structured FAQ schema directly into product templates allowed Equifax to capture Google rich snippets and answer user questions in SERPs, significantly driving qualified organic acquisition.

Impact & Results

The data-led redesign achieved significant increases across user engagement, organic discoverability, and conversion efficiency across all primary commercial templates.

1. Homepage Transformation

Strategic traffic routing successfully filtered high-intent traffic into commercial conversion funnels, resulting in higher acquisition quality and higher overall yields despite targeted session moderation.

Metric Before Redesign After Redesign Performance Shift
Sessions 1,652,368 1,242,987 ⬆ +32.94% Efficiency (Strategic Redirection)
Users 873,755 698,794 ⬆ +25.04% Quality Index
New Users 839,101 675,046 ⬆ +24.30% Acquisition Quality
Conversion Rate (CvR) 6.70% 9.00% ⬆ +35.00% CvR Growth
Total Conversions 45,488 54,493 ⬆ +19.80% Absolute Growth

Source: GA4 Analytics Data

2. Credit Report & Score Landing Page

Rebuilding this primary revenue-generating page with transparent product tiers, interactive accordions, and visible trust signals significantly increased dwell time and subscription intent.

Metric Before Redesign After Redesign Performance Shift
Average Engagement Time 1m 28s 2m 01s ⬆ +31.62% Time-on-Page
Total Conversions 995 1,338 ⬆ +34.47% Conversions
Conversion Rate (CvR) 6.70% 10.40% ⬆ +55.40% CvR Increase
Page 1 Keyword Rankings Baseline YoY Growth ⬆ +56.00% (SEMrush)
Total Keyword Rankings Baseline YoY Growth ⬆ +139.00% (SEMrush)

3. Statutory Credit Report Landing Page

Modernising this statutory regulatory journey removed unnecessary cognitive load, resulting in major gains in time-on-page and completed report requests.

Metric Before Redesign After Redesign Performance Shift
Sessions 16,858 18,271 ⬆ +8.38% Organic Traffic
Users 14,068 14,645 ⬆ +4.10% Unique Visitors
Average Engagement Time 1m 50s 2m 38s ⬆ +44.92% Time-on-Page
Total Conversions 2,040 3,009 ⬆ +47.50% Total Conversions
Pre/Post Conversion Rate 13.10% 20.80% ⬆ +58.60% CvR Growth

Tools and Skills Applied

Category Tools / Skills
UX & UI Design Figma, Adobe XD, Wireframing, Rapid Prototyping, Design Systems, Information Architecture
Frontend Engineering React, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance), Component Testing
CRO & Analytics Optimizely, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Glassbox, Hotjar, User Funnel Analysis, A/B Testing
Technical & Search SEO SEMrush, Schema Markup (Structured Data), Keyword Strategy, Long-Tail Query Mapping
Delivery & Governance Jira, GitHub, Stakeholder Management, Financial Compliance Review Alignment

Roles Performed on this Project

  • Design & Development Manager: Oversaw the programme roadmap, alignment between engineering and creative tracks, and technical sign-offs.
  • Senior UX/Product Designer: Spearheaded discovery, journey mapping, low-to-high fidelity wireframing, and interactive usability prototypes.
  • CRO Specialist: Developed testing hypotheses, planned Optimizely experiments, and validated performance shifts using GA4 and Glassbox.
  • Frontend Developer: Built accessible, modular React templates and responsive stylesheets in alignment with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
  • Technical SEO Strategist: Formulated URL structure, header hierarchies, and rich metadata schemas to capture organic search traffic.

User research and behavioural analytics indicated an outdated aesthetic, cognitive overload, and low visual trust across critical credit product journeys. As Design and Development Manager, I directed a multi-disciplinary initiative unifying user experience (UX) design, modular React frontend engineering, Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) compliance, and search engine optimisation (SEO). By establishing an evidence-based experimentation pipeline using Optimizely and Glassbox alongside an overhauled responsive design system, we streamlined user journeys and clarified value propositions. The intervention reversed key drop-offs, delivering a +35.0% conversion rate lift on the homepage, a +55.4% increase on the Credit Report & Score landing page, and a +139% expansion in organic commercial keyword rankings.
